name: The Pot That Had a Baby
shortDescription: Byantaka convinces his neighbour that a large clay pot has had a baby, setting off a hilarious village misunderstanding.
longDescription: When Byantaka borrows his neighbour’s precious clay pot, he returns it with a tiny pot inside and claims it has had a baby. His delighted neighbour believes the impossible story and eagerly expects more. But when Byantaka later says the pot has died, the dispute goes before the village judge, who teaches both men a lesson about greed, honesty and working together.
